headerDisplay: US MyNISSAN / Ariya. Sign in above. One accessory per vehicle; names do not affect pairing. Remote actions require Nissan service entitlement.

pythonPath.title: Python executable override (advanced, optional)
pythonPath.description: Leave blank for automatic setup. The plugin downloads a private runtime and dependencies inside Homebridge storage; system Python is not changed.

authFile.title: Absolute path to token file
authFile.description: Defaults to nissan-connect/auth.json inside Homebridge storage. File must be owned by the Homebridge user and readable only by that user.

staleAfter.title: Mark unavailable after no successful API read (seconds)

includeLocation.title: Expose location and Locate Vehicle command

name.title: Vehicle name
name.description: Change this and restart Homebridge to rename without changing accessory identity. Apple Home may retain its own name; edit that in Home.
